title: chore(north-star, pm-dispatch): six product areas and grading tables, filing-time labels, hand-set grades kept, scope guard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ81Cy8fcqhu4fUzVxLgoANMe)_

Fixes #35206
Fixes #35207
Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#4870
Part of objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2656
Part of objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2658

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none


## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个 PR 装下专题卡 35205 的规则部分。北极星写入 6 个产品大专题和两张定级表（这一半原样合并自 PR 35214）；pm-dispatch 改成「先判仓库、专题和类型，再查表定级」，不再自己抄表；你亲手定的级车队不再改，有异议只留一行评论、卡的状态不动；当前值（冻结、暂停、重点、只做 p1、并发）和卡号、评论 id、带日期的引文不再写进技能；cloud 和 hotcrm 两个车道文件缩成指针，各仓的规则住各仓；标签脚本换成本仓 8 个 `area:*`，并带上 cloud 的 9 个；`area:cloud` 改成「和 cloud 仓库相关的卡」，定义里不再写暂停；改标签的工具在动 `priority:*` 前先读是谁定的级；中继的 `issue_patch` 能写 issue 类型（Bug / Feature / Task）；防小事做大（你 16:58Z 同意的 B 包 10 条）：每张卡首行写来源 `Source:`，新接口、新协议键、新能力一律另立 Feature 卡、不作缺陷卡的修法选项，车队自提的 Feature（改善体验的也算）定 p3，其中没有预先授权的不派发、由分诊每周列一张清单给你挑、不自动关；改善体验的 Feature 只有来源是你或专题时才默认 p2（北极星同一句话一起改了），缺陷只修到症状消失并把文档改成实情，车队自提的大活派发前先过一道独立的范围评审；p1 两行（A 包）：`security` 标签不定级，「具名客户」只指真实外部用户。
- 为什么改：你 14:43Z「立一张专题卡，开始执行」；15:18Z 你说在 GitHub 改了优先级又被分诊改回去；15:19Z 你说座位帖上临时交代的事变成了长期技能；15:27Z 你要求专题卡下的任务一个 PR 集中处理；16:20Z 你说「包括 hotcrm 每个仓库的规则都在自己仓库」；16:29Z 你说「area:cloud 不要暂停」；16:57Z 你说「p1 的定级不是大问题，大问题是小开发放大」；17:44Z 你在决策卡上选定：来源是你或专题的体验类 Feature 默认 p2，车队自提的一律 p3 进每周清单。
- 风险与回滚：规则文本、PM 脚本和 16 个清单区的 `axis` 字段，不动产品代码，不删任何旧标签。最大的行为变化在 `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`：凡是人定的级，车队改级会被拒，要带 `Ruling-ref:` 行引你的原话才放行；专题卡第 5 步重定级会碰到它。cloud 和 hotcrm 车道文件里删掉的内容，新家已在那两个仓的 main 上。中继的类型字段合并进 main 后才生效。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` 的 `refuseHandSetGrade` 和 `isFleetLabelEvent`（判「人还是车队」的那两段）；② `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` 第 22–25 行和第 32–35 行（当前值与出处不进技能、人定的级不改），以及 `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 第 148–152 行（范围评审）；③ `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/cloud.md` 和 `lanes/hotcrm.md`（删掉了什么、留下了什么）。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test`，预期末行是 `✓ label-write self-test: 300 cases pass across 18 batteries`。
- 需要你做的：审后合并本 PR（契约评审 PASS 6988773607，Head-sha f7034cff42fa632b9e19248cc7ebd39e27b01715）。

## What changes

One pull request for the rule half of epic 35205, as the maintainer asked at 15:27Z. Three parts.

**1. North-star half, merged unchanged from PR 35214** (`git merge` of `claude/project-thread-toqege` at `b8411ab70f75345c0e5f338e00a7d40115d9bdf8`): `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `AGENTS.md` rule 8. Product areas (six product areas plus fleet and cloud, security in the private channel only), the Bug severity × reach table, the security table, the extra rules, Features on the road regrouped by area, Priority rule 2 as two steps and rule 3 as the take order. `ROADMAP.md` and `AGENTS.md` are byte-identical to that head, and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is identical except the three hunks below, two for `area:cloud` and one for the UX Feature default (see Verification). The review records on PR 35214 carry for everything else in the three files: contract review PASS 6983090596 (deltas on 6982681927 and 6982541233) and L1 delta ACCEPT 6983400678 (on 6982956305).

**The two `area:cloud` hunks in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` were written after that head and owe a delta review** (the maintainer, 16:28–16:29Z: 「area:cloud 就是和 cloud 仓库相关的不简单吗」, 「area:cloud 不要暂停」, 「ok」):

- Line 25, the area table row. Before: `area:cloud` Hosted dependencies · work in this repository done for the cloud; problems that appear only in the hosted environment · follows the cloud cards · paused (follows the cloud lane). After: `area:cloud` Cloud-related · any card related to the cloud repository: a card that needs to read cloud code, or a change that serves only the hosted edition · follows the cloud cards · not product. The display name changed with the definition, because "Hosted dependencies" does not describe a card that reads cloud code.
- Line 32, the boundary bullet. Before: a problem that appears only in the hosted environment always goes to `area:cloud`, and is graded all the same. After: a card related to the cloud repository (it needs to read cloud code, or its change serves only the hosted edition, a problem that appears only in the hosted environment included) always goes to `area:cloud`, in place of its product area, and is graded all the same.

**A third hunk in `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, also after that head, owes the contract-review delta too** (the maintainer's pick at 17:44Z on the decision card, relayed by seat 1):

- Line 139, Priority rule 2, step two. Before: A Feature that improves UX defaults to p2; any other Feature never enters p1. After: A Feature that improves UX defaults to p2 when its source is the maintainer or a topic (an epic he opened or confirmed); a fleet-sourced Feature, UX included, is p3 and, unless pre-authorised, goes on the weekly list, which triage owns; any other Feature never enters p1. Nothing else in the sentence or the rule changes. The words "unless pre-authorised" are seat 1's answer to the open question of the previous round: a pre-authorised fleet-sourced Feature (the kinds of package B item 3) is not held for the list, which matches the scope of item 4 in the skill text. It is the same third hunk, in its final form.

Paused is a state an area can be in, not part of its definition, so the word left the row. The label description in `ensure-pm-labels.sh` says the same thing in 100 characters. pm-dispatch does not define the area (it points at the north star), so no skill line changes for it.

**2. pm-dispatch text** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`). The skill points at the tables and does not restate them; it keeps the mechanisms every repository shares.

- `references/filing-gate.md`
  - Grading section rewritten as a pointer plus what the fleet does with it. This repository reads the north star (Product areas, Priority rule 2); cloud reads its own `docs/strategy/core-functions.md`; the two steps are the same for both. Step one judges the repository, then `area:*` and issue type. Step two points at Priority rule 2: only Bug and security cards use the tables. The Feature, Task and UX defaults, "a card in flight may be raised, never lowered" and the p0 list are read from the north star and are no longer restated here (see Acceptance notes, what paid for package B); the release-window sentence for p0 stays. The grade line `area · type · severity · reach · evidence (measured or read)`; a public card's line names no security mechanism.
  - Security, one clause: a security problem in this repository is a private advisory and carries no `area:*`; cloud's security cards follow the cloud lane (cloud is a private repository and has `area:security`).
  - Deleted: the old p0–p3 rows, the protocol-addition definitions, rules 1–8 (rule 8's focus adjustment included) and the inheritance of a checklist item's priority.
  - Filing gate, new: a card the fleet files carries area, type, grade and the grade line, or it is refused; a card from the maintainer or an outside person is completed at triage's first touch.
  - Filing gate, new, the hand-set grade: a grade a person set is not changed. Before changing a grade, read the newest `labeled` event of the grade the card carries; it is the fleet's only when it carries `performed_via_github_app` or a bot actor; every other event is a person's. To disagree: one comment line with the reason, and nothing else; the grade and the card's state stay (contract review S3, answered by seat 1 at 18:41Z: the maintainer's grade is final, so a disputed grade must not park the card; the earlier `pm:awaiting-maintainer` routing is gone from the rule and from the refusal `label-write.mjs` prints).
  - Filing gate, new, at the rule-card line: current values (freeze, pause, focus, "p1 only", concurrency) never go into a skill and live only in seat posts and project memory; a one-card ruling lives only on its card; only a standing rule goes into a skill, on the maintainer's explicit long-term wording or his merge of the rule PR. A skill PR body quotes each source; L1 and L2 send back a citation that reads as temporary or was said to one seat only.
  - Filing gate, new, one sentence beside it: card numbers, comment ids and dated quotes stay out of skill text; a rule's provenance lives only in the pull request that lands it. No existing citation is deleted here (that sweep is card 35215); the text this pull request adds carries none.
  - Category ④ keeps cross-repo and cross-layer coordination parents and now says they are `tracking`, never `pm:epic`. **Please review**: this is the one place the "sub-epics are opened only by the maintainer" rule meets a parent card that seats do open.
- `references/triage-duties.md`: first touch reviews area, type, grade and the `Source:` line of every new card and keeps the old value when it changes one; the daily fire sweeps public cards with no `area:*`; the `Path:` line and its close rule are gone (the two steps are in `filing-gate.md` and the north star); the issue type is written through the relay's `issue_patch`; disjunct ⑤ still first-touches whoever applied the label and keeps a person's grade; "grades are set only in this round, not at filing" now reads "set at filing, reviewed in this round"; the hold self-repair no longer demotes to p3; a cross-layer coordination parent is `area:*` plus `tracking`, not `pm:epic`. The Feature and fix-scope lines of package B are below.
- `references/lanes/triage.md`: the focus list is gone; dispatch order is the area or sub-epic the maintainer names, and the grade only decides queue-jumping; a sub-epic (a temporary `pm:epic`) is opened only by the maintainer; the `security` label sets no grade, the security table does (package A).
- `references/execution-duties.md`: take order is north-star Priority rule 3; label order p0, then p1 from any area (paused ones included), then the next card of the named area or sub-epic; inside it p2 before p3. The two lines that ordered cloud's enterprise cards by `cloud/ROADMAP.md` rows are one line: cloud dispatches by epic too, and its details are in the cloud repository. The line 「`pm:blocking` 的写入与摘除都在分诊轮 sweep,依赖者全关即摘。」 now lives here, moved word for word from the runbook section that was deleted.
- `references/coordinator.md`, `references/area-lease.md`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md`: the take surface is p0 and p1 first, then the next card of the named area or sub-epic; the grade decides queue-jumping only. The runbook's own take-order section is deleted (it paid for the scope-review block; `execution-duties.md` still says a card with no grade, area or type is reported as a triage gap).
- `references/seat-lifecycle.md`: a sub-epic is a parent the maintainer opened, with no default epic seat; `pm:epic` is limited to parents the maintainer opened; both repositories dispatch by epic in the order the maintainer names (the `cloud/ROADMAP.md` order is gone); a paused parent's children keep their grades.
- `references/lanes/director.md`: the weekly re-read of `cloud/ROADMAP.md` still reports stale rows; it no longer checks table order against grades, because the table is not the take order.
- `references/lanes/spec.md`, `references/lanes/skills.md`: the lane-local grading sentences are now a suggestion to triage, written as a `Suggested-grade:` line; the grade is triage's. No script reads that line.
- `SKILL.md` label table (`pm:on-hold`, `pm:blocking`, `pm:epic`, `area:*` rows) and the close rule, `references/state-machine.md`: entering hold no longer demotes; `pm:blocking` raises no grade and jumps no queue; `pm:epic` is a sub-epic only the maintainer opens; `area:*` is the product area, one per public card, none on this repository's security cards, set at triage's first touch; a closed card keeps its issue type.
- **Each repository's rules live in that repository** (the maintainer, 16:19Z and 16:20Z):
  - `references/lanes/hotcrm.md` goes from 53 lines to 21 (a lowering against `main`). It keeps the shared seat mechanics (the seat's shape, no `domain:*`, the manual half-state check because hotcrm has no patrol workflow, `ensure-pm-labels.sh` as a landing step), one pointer to `cross-repo-coordination.md` for the three cross-repo mechanics (how a platform-gap card is filed and back-linked with `Blocked-by:`; the `repo:hotcrm` seam label only on true coordination cards; a platform card's `domain:*` and type belong to triage), which that file already states for every repository, and one pointer: hotcrm's rules live in hotcrm's `AGENTS.md` (Scope; Product, priorities and the development process; Platform Upgrades) and `docs/PRIORITIES.md` (areas, first touch, grades, stage × document). The earlier draft of this pull request carried a simplified-first-touch section here; it is gone, and its content goes to hotcrm pull request 2657.
  - `references/lanes/cloud.md` goes from 28 lines to 19. This is cloud seat 1's text (`Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#4870`). It keeps the seat's shape and the cross-repo mechanics (a card blocked on an objectstack card, the `triage#1` knock, the 4-hour fallback, the release board) and replaces the rest with one pointer: first touch, grading, take order, enterprise and security-card rules are in cloud's `docs/strategy/triage-rules.md` and `docs/strategy/core-functions.md`. That removes the "p1 only" line (a current value) and the three CI-minute lines.
  - The pointer is one bullet on two physical lines in both files: it does not fit the 120-byte line budget on one.
- **Cross-repo grade, one sentence, worded as the north star words it** (`filing-gate.md`, echoed in `dispatch-runbook.md`; seat 1's answer 4): 「挡住别仓 p1 的卡取该 p1 的级,`Feature` 亦然;此外级 ⛔ 不沿链继承,「有人在等」不升级。」 A card that blocks another repository's p1 takes that card's grade, a Feature included; otherwise the grade is not inherited up the chain, and "someone is waiting" raises no grade. The earlier, wider wording (the blocked card's grade whenever it is higher) is gone, so **the hotcrm case "blocks a hotcrm card of any grade, takes that grade" is no longer covered**: only a blocked p1 passes its grade on.

- **Package B, "stop small work growing", and package A, two p1 lines** (the maintainer, 16:48Z to 16:58Z; its own commit `56d88ea0`). Every line is paid by deletion and no ceiling moves:
  - B1, `filing-gate.md`: beside the category, a card's first line names its source, `Source: maintainer | topic #N | fleet`. `maintainer` is the maintainer's own card, or one that quotes him with a link; `topic` is a child of an epic he opened or confirmed; everything else is `fleet`, and so is a card with no positive evidence. A card a test agent files carries a seat signature too. `triage-duties.md`: first touch checks `Source:` with area, type and grade and writes `fleet` when it cannot verify it.
  - B2, `filing-gate.md` and `SKILL.md`: a new endpoint, protocol key, metadata type, audit kind or capability is its own Feature card, never an option on a Bug, and triage splits a Bug that carries one. The `SKILL.md` sentence 「改协议单独立卡」 now covers new public surface. The ①-category line that sent redesign and new-feature proposals to a decision card now sends them to a Feature card.
  - B3, `triage-duties.md`: pre-authorised Features need no ruling: children of a `Source: topic` epic, a capability a north-star road row already asserts, carrying out an existing ruling, a new key with a precedent. The human-floor line now reads "a new feature that is not pre-authorised".
  - B4, `triage-duties.md`, `filing-gate.md` and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` (with the 17:44Z pick): a fleet-sourced Feature is p3, UX-improving ones included; a UX-improving Feature defaults to p2 only when its source is the maintainer or a topic. The fleet-sourced Features that are not pre-authorised are not dispatched, get no decision card and are never closed automatically; triage writes one weekly list, and the maintainer picks, folds into an epic, or says which ones close. Such a card files under gate category ② without the decision-box step (seat 1, 17:44Z): the category line says 「车队 `Feature` 归此,免决策箱」. The decision-box definition no longer lists feature proposals.
  - B5 and B9, `triage-duties.md`: a Bug is fixed until the symptom on the card is gone and the docs say what is true, corrected in the same pull request together with what is still not covered; the long-term ordering only picks a shape inside that scope. `SKILL.md`: the line "this order only ranks the recommendation" adds "and does not widen the fix scope". `decision-analysis.md`: 「分期半量」 now carries 「(缺陷除外)」.
  - B6 to B8, `dispatch-runbook.md`, in the pre-dispatch section: a `Source: fleet` plan that hits any workload criterion (the existing list in `triage-duties.md`) or needs two or more pull requests gets a scope review before dispatch; other sources and already-ruled routes are exempt. An isolated agent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` gets the card and the plan only, never the seat's recommendation, and answers three questions: the minimal change, the items beyond the card, and who asked for each (a road row, an epic's card number, a ruling, or a real customer's own words). The verdict is one line on the card, `Scope-review: 照做 | 砍到最小 | 拆分 · 最小项 · 超出项及出处`. When an item beyond the card has no source, only the minimal item is dispatched and the rest is split into Feature cards; a split is not 「砍半」; a minimal item that hits no human floor gets no decision card.
  - B10, `dispatch-runbook.md` and `l1-review-checklist.md`: a diff beyond the verdict line is REWORK, and the L1 scope criterion now reads "no file outside the card or beyond `Scope-review:`"; L2 still reviews only the contract.
  - A1, `lanes/triage.md`: the `security` label sets no grade; the security table does. The wording 「只定 `security`+p1」 had already left this branch; the line now says it outright.
  - A2, `filing-gate.md`: 「具名客户」 means a real external user only; the grade comment says who said what; a need from a test agent's own application does not count. Nothing else is added for p1: no new cells, no daily list, no seven-day review.
- **`domain:cloud` row of `SKILL.md`** (seat 1's answer 2): the row now says a cloud-related card takes `area:cloud` (「专题打 `area:cloud`」) and keeps its ownership rule; the row is not retired. Its pointer to `references/lanes/cloud.md` left the row to keep it under the 341-byte row pin (it is 333 bytes); the criteria pointer to `cross-repo-coordination.md` stays.

- **Who sets area, type and grade on a card the fleet files** (L1 REWORK R1 with contract review S1; commit `f7034cff`). `filing-gate.md` lines 32 and 33 are the rule and win over every other line: a card the fleet files carries area, type and grade from its filer or the gate refuses it; triage completes a maintainer's or an outsider's card at first touch, and reviews a fleet card and changes it with a reason line. The lines that still gave the job to triage alone now say the same, each changed only where it contradicted:
  - `SKILL.md`, the `area:*` row: 「分诊首触打」 became 「车队卡立卡席打,分诊首触补齐复核」. To stay under the 341-byte row pin (the row is 338 bytes) three words left its reader list (「里」, 「的…清单」, 「次」 of 「取卡次序」); no reader is dropped.
  - `lanes/hotcrm.md` line 12: a platform card's `domain:*` belongs to triage; 「与 type」 is gone, because the filer sets the type.
  - `cross-repo-coordination.md` line 4: central triage is the only producer of `domain:*`; type and grade follow the filing gate; the lane self-triage exception stays. Line 34: triage is the only producer of routing, dedupe, shadow and `duplicate_of`; 「type」 left that list and the line's tail now says "type and grade: see above".
  - `lanes/objectstack.md` line 10: first touch and `domain:*` stay with triage; a card this lane files carries area, type and grade. The lane still neither produces nor changes `domain:*`.
  - `lanes/qa.md` line 26: a defect card the QA seat extracts carries area, type and grade and goes to first touch as before; it still does not enter the queue. 「不定级」 is gone.
  - `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the comment above the area rows: "a filer may pre-apply both" became the same rule in words (contract review S1 named it).
  - What stands unchanged: `domain:*`, routing, dedupe and the queue state stay triage's alone in every one of these lines. Not written here, as before: the mechanical refusal and how a filer sets the type through the relay (#35247).

**3. Scripts and checklist data.**

- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`
  - This repository's area block holds the eight values (`area:ai`, `area:build`, `area:data`, `area:workflow`, `area:ux`, `area:package`, `area:fleet`, `area:cloud`), colour `d2dae2`, descriptions at most 100 characters. `area:cloud` reads "Not product — related to the cloud repo: needs to read cloud code, or serves only the hosted edition". No label is renamed or deleted; the header comment lists the retired ones and says so. `--reconcile` gives the five labels that were auto-created grey (`area:build`, `area:ux`, `area:package`, `area:fleet`, `area:cloud`) their colour and description, and rewrites the descriptions of `area:ai`, `area:data` and `area:workflow`.
  - Nine rows for the cloud repository's own areas (`area:control`, `area:environment`, `area:marketplace`, `area:ai`, `area:enterprise`, `area:security`, `area:ops`, `area:fleet`, `area:ux`), same colour, with cloud seat 1's descriptions copied as given (they are in Chinese). **The nine label objects already exist on cloud, grey and with no description, so the default mode changes nothing there; `--reconcile` run against cloud is what sets colour and description.** The script is the one place the fleet's label vocabulary is created, which is why the rows are here; what each area means is defined in the cloud repository and the comment says so.
  - The `priority:p0` and `pm:blocking` comments follow the new order.
- `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`: the hand-set grade guard. A write whose target changes the card's set of `priority:*` labels reads the card's label events first; when the newest `labeled` event of a carried grade is not the fleet's, the write is refused at step ② with exit 2 and zero writes. A `Ruling-ref:` line in the comment folded into the write (`--comment-file`) is the one way through. A first grade on an ungraded card and a write that touches no grade read nothing.
- `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` (`ops.mjs`, `validate.mjs`, `execute.mjs`): the relay's `issue_patch` takes an optional `type`, the native issue type by name, exactly one of `Bug`, `Feature`, `Task`, PATCHed on the issue with the other keys. The validator refuses any other value, and the key on any other op. The executor fails an action whose answer names another type or none, so a type the platform did not apply is never a quiet success. The organization's issue-types API answers 403 to this integration, so the three names are a closed list in the op table. **The relay workflow runs the op table on `main`: a seat can set a type only after this pull request merges.**
- `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs`: a daily area backstop row (open cards with no `area:*`, never part of the verdict); the fifth disjunct's text says what its touch adds.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: H11 reads the native issue type first; the `bug` label speaks only for a card with no native type, until the old type labels retire. One remedy sentence no longer names the `Path:` line.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: two ceilings lowered to the landed counts (`lanes/hotcrm.md` 53 to 21, `lanes/cloud.md` 28 to 19). The `execution-duties.md` entry is byte-identical to `main` again at 190: the earlier lowering to 189 is undone because the restored `pm:blocking` line takes the line the cloud ROADMAP-order deletion had freed. No ceiling is raised and the ratchet's mechanics are untouched.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`: the `"axis"` field of the 16 area files now names the product area (13 files change, 3 keep their value).

| automation | workflow | workflow |
